response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and leadership in diverse projects, but lacks proven executive-level leadership, formal project management experience, and crucially, only has basic German proficiency — a hard requirement for the role. His UML and architecture design experience are implied but not explicitly demonstrated.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Proven full-stack expertise across languages, platforms, and embedded systems
Strong track record of mentoring and creating technical workshops/courses
concerns: German proficiency is only basic, falling far short of the required C1 level
No explicit evidence of IT architecture design, UML modeling, or requirements management in leadership context
Lacks documented experience managing teams or leading client-facing technical strategy at executive level
